From 40b3f06f9d13b19ce0ceb16b9c10e1772c5acdd7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mark Robert Miller <markrmiller@apache.org>
Date: Wed, 3 Aug 2011 16:18:17 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] SOLR-2331,SOLR-2691: Refactor CoreContainer's SolrXML
 serialization code and improve testing

git-svn-id: https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/lucene/dev/trunk@1153564 13f79535-47bb-0310-9956-ffa450edef68

diff --git a/solr/CHANGES.txt b/solr/CHANGES.txt
index b13965d24a9..b12c0eb423a 100644
--- a/solr/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/solr/CHANGES.txt
@@ -281,6 +281,9 @@ Other Changes
 * SOLR-2663: FieldTypePluginLoader has been refactored out of IndexSchema 
   and made public. (hossman)
 
+* SOLR-2331,SOLR-2691: Refactor CoreContainer's SolrXML serialization code and improve testing
+  (Yury Kats, hossman, Mark Miller)
+
 Documentation
 ----------------------
 

diff --git a/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/core/CoreContainer.java b/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/core/CoreContainer.java
index fd63fbfa72f..c383b0b8801 100644
--- a/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/core/CoreContainer.java
+++ b/solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/core/CoreContainer.java
@@ -903,8 +903,8 @@ public class CoreContainer
     List<SolrCoreXMLDef> solrCoreXMLDefs = new ArrayList<SolrCoreXMLDef>();
     
     synchronized (cores) {
-      Map<String,String> coreAttribs = new HashMap<String,String>();
       for (SolrCore solrCore : cores.values()) {
+        Map<String,String> coreAttribs = new HashMap<String,String>();
         CoreDescriptor dcore = solrCore.getCoreDescriptor();
         
         coreAttribs.put("name", dcore.name.equals("") ? defaultCoreName

### Modifications in Each File

1. **solr/CHANGES.txt**
   - Added an entry to document the changes made in the patch, specifically mentioning the refactoring of CoreContainer's SolrXML serialization code and improvements in testing. This entry is associated with issues SOLR-2331 and SOLR-2691, and it credits the contributors.

2. **solr/core/src/java/org/apache/solr/core/CoreContainer.java**
   - Modified the code to refactor the initialization of `coreAttribs` within a synchronized block. The `coreAttribs` variable has been moved inside the loop that iterates over `cores.values()`, ensuring it is reinitialized for each `SolrCore`. This change likely aims to improve clarity and maintainability of the code.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The addition in **CHANGES.txt** provides documentation for the changes made in **CoreContainer.java**. The patch addresses specific issues (SOLR-2331 and SOLR-2691) by refactoring the serialization code for CoreContainer, which is implied by the code changes. The modifications to the Java file enhance the functionality and reliability of the serialization process, thereby fulfilling the objectives stated in the changes log. The relationship signals an effort to improve not just the code quality but also the testing frameworks associated with the CoreContainer, indicating a broader initiative to enhance the codebase's robustness.
